result.title: On Learning Expand-and-Sparsify Representations
result.summary: Expand-and-sparsify ($\texttt{EaS}$) representations lift an input to a much higher dimension through a linear map and keep only the $k$ largest coordinates. Existing theory builds that map at random and needs the expanded dimension to grow exponentially in the input dimension, which puts the construction out of practical reach. We ask what is gained by learning the map by gradient descent instead, and how that gain depends on how wide the expansion is. We sweep $73$ OpenML classification tasks and $48$ regression tasks under a protocol that holds the datasets, expanded dimensions, sparsity levels and splits fixed across every method, and we summarise each comparison by a median over datasets and a Wilcoxon signed rank test. We report four findings. First, learning the expansion helps most when the expansion is narrowest, and its advantage over a random map decays to nothing by the widest expansions we run, so a learned $\texttt{EaS}$ layer can be made small. Second, with the map learned, a top-$k$ representation that keeps at most a tenth of its coordinates is indistinguishable from a dense $\texttt{ReLU}$ layer of the same expanded dimension at every expansion factor we test, while GELU and SiLU are not. Third, when the representation is forced to be binary the sparse code is the better of the two, and the reason is that binarization costs it nothing while it costs the dense layer accuracy. Fourth, how sparse the representation can be is governed by how wide it is: the sparsity level that is free rises as the expansion grows, so there is no fixed limit on how sparse it can be. The regression tasks reproduce the first finding and qualify the second and third.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究用梯度下降学习 expand-and-sparsify 的线性映射相比随机映射的收益，并考察该收益随扩展宽度的变化，在 73 个 OpenML 分类与 48 个回归任务上固定数据、扩展维度、稀疏度和划分做对照实验，报告最窄扩展时学习收益最大、top-k 稀疏表示可与同维 dense ReLU 相当、二值化下稀疏码更优、可承受的稀疏度随扩展宽度上升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「扩展宽度决定可自由稀疏的上限」「top-k 保留多少坐标才不损失信息」等问题结构与 LVR 中 latent 状态的容量、稀疏程度和信息坍缩可能相关，可供核查是否影响内部状态保留视觉细节的假设，但该工作针对表格任务，与多模态推理无直接关联。
